description: Add a client-side, auth-gated preview route at app/preview/articles/[id]/page.tsx that reads the CURRENT DRAFT (drafts.<id>, falling back to the published <id>) using the authenticated getAdminClient() — the only client that can see drafts within the browser-only auth model — resolves author/category references and image URLs exactly the way lib/sanity-queries.ts `articleFullFields` does, and renders the shared <ArticleView> from FEAT-001. Wrap it in the same public typography/container context so fonts/styling match the live site, and mark the whole /preview segment noindex. This is why it works within browser-only auth: it is a client component, so getAdminClient() attaches the per-user session token from sessionStorage (same origin, already logged in) and can read the unpublished draft that a server component never could. Depends on FEAT-001 (ArticleView).
steps: Create app/preview/layout.tsx: a small layout for the preview segment. Export `metadata` with `robots: { index: false, follow: false }` so the preview is never indexed (mirrors app/admin/layout.tsx). It renders `{children}` inside a minimal wrapper (a plain <div> is fine; fonts come from the root app/layout.tsx which sets --font-inter/--font-playfair on <html> and imports globals.css, so all public typography utility classes work here without extra setup). Do NOT render the public Header/Footer (SiteLayout) or the AdminShell sidebar — the preview should look like a clean article page.

Create app/preview/articles/[id]/page.tsx as a client component ('use client'). Gate it with components/admin/AdminAuthGate so an unauthenticated visitor sees the same sign-in screen used elsewhere in /admin and only an authorized Sanity user can read the draft. Structure: `export default function PreviewArticlePage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) { return <AdminAuthGate><PreviewInner id={decodeURIComponent(params.id)} /></AdminAuthGate> }` where PreviewInner does the fetch + render.

In PreviewInner, on mount fetch the draft with getAdminClient().fetch using a GROQ query that mirrors articleFullFields so the resolved object matches the Article shape ArticleView expects. Use: `coalesce(*[_id == $draftId][0], *[_id == $id][0]){ _id, title, slug, excerpt, body, publishedAt, "imageUrl": mainImage.asset->url, "readingTime": round(length(pt::text(body)) / 5 / 200), seoTitle, seoDescription, faqs, "author": author->{ _id, name, slug, bio, jobTitle, credentials, sameAs, "imageUrl": image.asset->url }, "category": category->{ _id, title, slug, description } }` with params { id, draftId: `drafts.${id}` }. Type the result as `Article | null` (import Article from lib/sanity-queries.ts).

Render states: while loading show a centered spinner consistent with the admin loading style; on fetch error or missing document show an actionable message matching the /admin pattern (e.g. 'Draft not found, or you do not have access to it. Save the draft in the editor, then try Preview again.' with a note about Sanity permissions) plus a link back. On success render `<ArticleView article={article} authorSlug={article.author?.slug?.current} />`. ArticleView already renders the container-page/container-prose wrapper, so the preview page just needs to place it (optionally inside a top strip banner — see next step).

Add a small non-indexed 'Preview' banner strip at the very top of the successful render (e.g. a thin bar with text like 'Draft preview — not published. This is how the article will appear once live.') using existing utility/Tailwind classes (bg-gold-soft / eyebrow-royal etc.) so the author clearly understands they are viewing an unpublished draft. Keep it above the ArticleView container. This banner is preview-only and does not affect the public page.

Guard the category: ArticleView/preview assume article.category exists (public page does too). If a draft has no category yet, the resolved `category` will be null; handle gracefully by showing the actionable 'incomplete draft' message (category/author required) rather than crashing, since these are required fields the editor enforces before publish but a raw draft-save may omit. Mirror the editor's validation intent: if title/body render but category is missing, still attempt to render ArticleView defensively — but prefer a clear message if category is null since ArticleView reads article.category.title/slug.

Ensure no server-only APIs are used in the client route (no generateMetadata in a 'use client' file; the noindex comes from the layout's metadata export which is a server file). Confirm all imports are used (next lint).
acceptance_criteria: Navigating (while authenticated) to /preview/articles/<baseId> renders the draft article using the exact same ArticleView markup as the public /news/<slug> page, with matching fonts (Playfair/Inter), container widths (container-page/container-prose), headings, table, featured image, and FAQ.
The route reads drafts.<baseId> via getAdminClient() (authenticated per-user token), so UNPUBLISHED drafts render — verified by the query preferring the draft id.
An unauthenticated visitor to the preview URL sees the AdminAuthGate sign-in screen, not the draft.
The /preview segment is noindex (robots index:false via app/preview/layout.tsx metadata).
A missing/inaccessible draft shows an actionable message (not a crash), consistent with /admin error messaging.
No public Header/Footer or admin sidebar chrome is rendered on the preview page.
verification: Static review: confirm the GROQ projection field-for-field matches articleFullFields in lib/sanity-queries.ts so the fetched object satisfies the Article type consumed by ArticleView.
Static review: confirm 'use client' is present, getAdminClient() is used for the fetch, AdminAuthGate wraps the content, and app/preview/layout.tsx exports robots index:false metadata.
Static review: confirm no unused imports and no server-only API misuse in the client component.
On push, GitHub Actions CI (`npm ci && next build && next lint`) must pass. Deployed manual test in FEAT-003.
findings: Created app/preview/layout.tsx (server file, robots index:false/follow:false mirroring app/admin/layout.tsx; minimal <div className='min-h-screen bg-paper dark:bg-graphite'> wrapper — no SiteLayout Header/Footer and no AdminShell). Created app/preview/articles/[id]/page.tsx as a 'use client' component: PreviewArticlePage wraps <PreviewInner id={decodeURIComponent(params.id)} /> in <AdminAuthGate> (reuses the same sign-in screen + getSession verification as /admin, so an unauthenticated visitor sees 'Sign in to continue', not the draft). WHY CLIENT COMPONENT (per auth model in lib/sanity-admin.ts): only getAdminClient() attaches the per-user session token from sessionStorage IN THE BROWSER, so only it can read Sanity drafts (drafts.<id>). The public read client (lib/sanity.ts, useCdn:true, no token) cannot read drafts, and a server component has no access to the logged-in user's session, so it could never read the draft — hence the preview MUST be a client component. PreviewInner fetches via getAdminClient().fetch with a GROQ projection that mirrors articleFullFields field-for-field (coalesce draftId then id; params { id, draftId: `drafts.${id}` }); result typed as Article | null (imported from lib/sanity-queries.ts). Used the mounted/active-flag useEffect pattern from app/admin/page.tsx / ArticleEditor. States: loading = centered spinner matching admin loading style; missing/error = actionable message 'Draft not found, or you do not have access to it. Save the draft in the editor, then try Preview again.' + Sanity-permissions note + 'Back to Admin' link; incomplete (resolved category null) = 'Add a category before previewing' actionable message rather than crashing (ArticleView reads article.category.title/slug). Success renders a preview-only banner strip (bg-gold-soft / eyebrow-royal, 'Draft preview — not published. This is how the article will appear once live.') above <ArticleView article={article} authorSlug={article.author?.slug?.current} />, reusing the FEAT-001 presentational component so styling/layout/headings/table/featured image/FAQ match the live page exactly. No generateMetadata in the client file (noindex comes from the layout's metadata export). VERIFICATION: static review only — INTEGRATIONS_ONLY blocks npm/next build/lint/tsc (per context.json). Confirmed 'use client' present, all imports used (useEffect, useState, Link, getAdminClient, Article, AdminAuthGate, ArticleView), GROQ matches articleFullFields, and all Tailwind/utility classes used (container-page, container-prose, eyebrow-royal, bg-gold-soft, bg-paper, text-caption, text-display-3, border-hairline, bg-surface, etc.) exist in app/globals.css and tailwind.config.ts. CI (npm ci && next build && next lint) is the authoritative gate on push. FEAT-003 (Preview button in ArticleEditor that opens /preview/articles/<id> in a new tab) is intentionally out of scope for this feature.
